pageDescriptionEmpty: Members and guests of your organization.
pageDescription: Everyone in your organization – with or without a login. They appear in attendance, fines and tasks.

emptyState.title: No members yet
emptyState.description: Add members individually or import an existing list – they'll then be available for attendance, todos and fines.

emptyFiltered: No members found for the current filter.

csvPreview.title: CSV preview
csvPreview.description: {count, plural, =0 {No entries recognized.} one {# entry recognized.} other {# entries recognized.}}
csvPreview.columns: Recognized columns: Vorname, Nachname, Übername (or Anzeigename), Firmenname, Haupt-E-Mail (or E-Mail) – English headers such as First name, Last name, Email also work. Separator semicolon or comma.
csvPreview.help: People who already exist (same display name or same email) are skipped. New people get the «Reader» role and no login.
csvPreview.noRows: No person was recognized in this file. Check the column names in the first row or use the template.
csvPreview.noEmailColumn: No email column recognized: the people will be imported without an email address.

editModal.description: Master data, membership and templates. Roles are assigned under «Logins & roles».
editModal.joinedAtHint: Only appears in attendance lists from this date on. Empty = no start date set.
editModal.leftAtHint: From the following day, the person no longer appears in attendance lists or selection lists, and any login is blocked. Empty = no exit recorded.
editModal.notifyWithoutLogin: Send email notifications even though this person has no login
editModal.notifyWithoutLoginHint: New tasks and reminders go to the stored email address.
editModal.notifyWithoutLoginHelp: People without a login only receive emails if you switch this on: new tasks and reminders to the stored address. Without a login the person cannot unsubscribe themselves.
editModal.notifyWithoutLoginNeedsEmail: This requires an email address for the person.
editModal.membershipHelp: Joining and leaving dates control which attendance lists the person appears in. «Inactive» marks the person as no longer active and blocks a login without deleting data.

toasts.leftBeforeJoined: Leave date cannot be before the join date
toasts.deleteConfirmMessage: Permanently delete member? This cannot be undone.
toasts.bulkDeleteConfirmMessage: Permanently delete {count} members? This cannot be undone.

personalData.title: Personal data of {name}
personalData.description: All data stored in hocX about this person as a password-protected ZIP file (Excel and JSON). The download is recorded in the activity log.

invite.title: Invitation by email
invite.hint: Instead of setting a password: the person receives a link and sets their own password. Sign-in becomes active once they accept the invitation.
invite.needsEmail: An invitation needs a saved email address for this person.
invite.pendingQueued: The invitation will be sent shortly.
invite.revokeConfirm: Withdraw the invitation to {name}? The link in the email will no longer work.
invite.sentToast: The invitation to {email} is being sent.
invite.failed: The invitation could not be processed.
invite.mailOff: Email invitations are not possible because email sending is not set up.
invite.saveEmailFirst: The email address was changed: save first, then invite.

deleteDialog.title: Permanently delete «{name}»?
deleteDialog.message: The person disappears together with attendance, fines and task assignments; this cannot be undone. If they have only left, better set a leave date or «Inactive».
deleteDialog.messageWithLogin: The person disappears together with their login, attendance, fines and task assignments; this cannot be undone. If they should just no longer sign in, revoke the login instead (under «Logins & roles»).
deleteDialog.bulkTitle: {count, plural, one {Permanently delete # person?} other {Permanently delete # people?}}
deleteDialog.bulkMessage: The people disappear together with logins, attendance, fines and task assignments; this cannot be undone. For members who have left, better set a leave date.

list.description: Everyone in your organisation, with or without a login. Click a person to open everything about them: details, rate, login and roles.
list.footerHint: Click a row to open the person page

person.emailLoginHelp: This is also the login address. A change applies from the next login.
person.membershipHelp: Joining and leaving dates control which attendance lists the person appears in. A login is blocked from the leaving date.
person.tariffReadOnly: Rate: {tariff}. Only people with “Manage finances” can change it.
person.noLogin: No login. The person appears in attendance, fines and tasks but cannot sign in.
person.passwordDescription: Share the password with the person securely; they can change it in their profile afterwards. An email invitation is easier.
person.revokeHelp: Blocks sign-in and ends active sessions. The person remains a member.

blockers.displayName: Saving is blocked: the display name is missing.
blockers.dates: Saving is blocked: the leaving date is before the joining date.
blockers.loginEmail: Saving is blocked: the person needs an email address for their login.

person.previewHelp: Shows which menu items, permissions and submissions this account sees (read only, recorded in the activity log).
person.previewSavedOnly: The preview shows the saved state. Save the changed roles first.
person.previewNotAllowed: Only for accounts that don't have more permissions than you.

descriptions.master: Name and contact. The display name appears in lists, minutes and tasks.
descriptions.membership: Whether the person is active, since when they belong and which attendance lists they appear in.
descriptions.tariff: Which fine amounts apply to this person.
descriptions.login: Whether the person can sign in and what they may see and change in hocX.

person.emailLoginChanged: New login address – applies from the next login. The previous address {email} will be notified.
person.activeMemberHelp: Inactive people keep all their data, but their login is blocked.
person.noTemplates: No templates with an attendance list yet.
person.noTariffs: No fine rates set up yet.
person.tariffSingle: The organisation has only this rate; it applies to all members.
person.tariffDefaultHint: Default for everyone without their own rate
person.tariffMembers: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody yet} one {# member} other {# members}}
person.unsavedCount: {count, plural, one {# unsaved change} other {# unsaved changes}}

newMember.description: The person then appears in the member list. Without an invitation they remain a member without a login.
newMember.inviteHelp: The person sets their own password.

bulk.label: Bulk actions
bulk.invited: {count, plural, one {# person invited} other {# people invited}}
bulk.tariffSet: Rate set for {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}
bulk.rolesAdded: Role added for {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}
bulk.rolesRemoved: Role removed for {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}
bulk.inviteDescription: People with a login, without an email, inactive and former members are skipped.
bulk.inviteRoleHelp: You can assign further roles on the person page afterwards.
bulk.tariffTitle: Set rate for {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}
bulk.tariffDescription: The rate determines the amount of their fines.
bulk.rolesTitle: Roles for {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}
bulk.rolesDescription: Anything that would break a protection rule (e.g. last admin) or leave no role is skipped.
